IIM Nagpur Student Case Writing Competition 2027

Write an original teaching case (600–1,000 words, real scenario with a protagonist, dilemma and discussion questions) across strategy, finance, economics, marketing and other fields.

FIRST PRIZE
₹12,000
Reward details
Cash prizes of INR 12,000 / 8,000 / 5,000. Travel funding unspecified.
Registration deadline (case submission 5 January)
15 Jan 2027 (exact cutoff time not announced)
Format & location
Hybrid · Nagpur / online
Who can apply
UG and PG students across all streams. Coauthor cap, cross-university rules and faculty requirement not specified.
Team size
Check team rules

Entry notes

  • Fee INR 3,000 including GST domestic, US$50 overseas; early bird said to run through 5 December. Fee unit unclear.
  • Entry via CMT, conference code IIMNCRC2027, student case-writing track (login wall). Presentation 19 February, hybrid. AI-generated or plagiarised cases are rejected.
